user.title: Connect to Kameraposti
user.description: Enter your Kameraposti account details. These MQTT credentials are generated by Kameraposti and are separate from any MQTT broker you already use in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Kameraposti
reauth_confirm.description: Kameraposti rejected the stored password. Enter the current MQTT password for this account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kameraposti broker. Check your network connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Kameraposti rejected these credentials. Check the customer ID, username and password.

abort.already_configured: This Kameraposti account is already configured.
